deals.title: Spring package savings
deals.what: Save up to $250 a night on a room-and-ticket package of at least 4 nights with 4-day tickets.
deals.note: Limited availability. Can't be combined with other offers, and some room types are excluded.

deals.title: Spring room discount
deals.what: Up to 25% off rooms, with no tickets required.
deals.when: January 3 to April 29, 2027 (Sunday to Thursday nights only until February 25)

deals.title: Holiday room discount
deals.what: Up to 20% off rooms for the holidays.
deals.note: Can only be combined with the 2026 kids dining offer.

deals.title: Free dining plan for kids
deals.what: A free dining plan for kids ages 3 to 9 when the adults in your package have one.
deals.who: Anyone booking a Walt Disney Travel Company package with a dining plan
deals.when: Travel in 2026 only, so just a few weeks remain

deals.title: Winter prepay rate
deals.what: Lower, nonrefundable room rates when you pay up front.
deals.when: December 13 to 24, 2026, and January 3 to February 25, 2027
deals.note: No changes or cancellations. Minimum 2 nights.

deals.title: Florida resident deals
deals.what: 40% off 4-day tickets, 30% off 3-day tickets, and room discounts of up to 25% for the holidays and up to 30% in spring.
deals.when: Rooms through December 24, 2026, and January 3 to April 29, 2027
deals.note: Proof of residency is required at hotel check-in.

deals.title: Annual Passholder rooms
deals.what: Up to 30% off rooms for the holidays and up to 35% off in spring.
deals.when: Through December 24, 2026, and January 3 to April 29, 2027

deals.title: Military tickets and rooms
deals.what: Discounted tickets and rooms for U.S. military.
deals.when: Book the 2026 room offer by December 18, 2026, and the 2027 offer by December 21, 2027
deals.note: Tickets have blockout dates. Rooms are booked by phone.

deals.title: Disney+ 3-day, 3-park ticket
deals.what: A discounted 3-day ticket for EPCOT, Hollywood Studios and Animal Kingdom.

deals.title: Water park seasonal pass
deals.what: One pass for Typhoon Lagoon and Blizzard Beach through the spring.
deals.note: Blockout dates in February and March.

deals.title: Fall room discount
deals.what: Up to 20% off Disneyland Resort hotel rooms.
deals.when: Travel through December 18, 2026. Book by December 15, 2026.

deals.title: Winter room discount
deals.what: Up to 20% off rooms on weeknights.
deals.when: Sunday to Thursday nights, January 4 to February 25, 2027. Book by February 17, 2027.

deals.title: Magic Key holder rooms
deals.what: Up to 15% off in fall and up to 25% off in winter.

deals.title: Military tickets and rooms
deals.what: Discounted tickets and hotel rooms for U.S. military.
deals.when: Book rooms by December 27, 2026, or December 26, 2027
deals.note: Subject to theme park reservation availability.

deals.title: Limited-time sale
deals.what: 20% off the voyage fare plus onboard credit on select Disney Wish and Disney Dream sailings.
deals.when: Select sailings. Check Disney's page for dates.

deals.title: Up to 30% off select sailings
deals.what: Savings on the voyage fare on select sailings.
deals.when: Select sailings. Check Disney's page for dates.

deals.title: Florida resident sailings
deals.what: Up to 35% off select Bahamas and Caribbean sailings.

deals.title: Military rates
deals.what: Special rates for U.S. military, plus onboard credit on select sailings.
deals.note: New bookings only, one stateroom per member per sailing.
